headline: Attackers reinvented delivery this week—fragmenting malware for the browser to reassemble and handing live intrusions to autonomous AI agents—while an unpatched Fastjson flaw came under active exploitation.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers now ship malware in pieces and let SourTrade's victims reassemble the executable inside browser memory, slipping past scanners that expect one complete file at a fixed link.
emerging_trends.topic_title: SourTrade Malvertising Builds Malware in the Browser

emerging_trends.text: Criminals are wiring autonomous agents like Hermes straight into live intrusions, letting the software run post-exploitation on its own against targets as sensitive as Thailand's finance ministry.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Hermes AI Agent Automates Ministry Breach

emerging_trends.text: Package registries are answering supply-chain poisoning with delay, as GitHub and PyPI teach Dependabot to wait before pulling freshly published versions into projects.
emerging_trends.topic_title: GitHub and PyPI Add Time-Based Supply-Chain Defenses

topics.title: GitHub and PyPI Add Time-Based Supply-Chain Defenses
topics.latest_developments: GitHub and PyPI added a time-based mechanism to the Dependabot dependency tool on July 26, 2026, delaying adoption of freshly published package versions to blunt supply-chain attacks and limit their spread.
topics.summary: The cooldown gives maintainers and scanners a window to catch a malicious release before projects pull it automatically. Developers who rely on Dependabot gain a buffer against poisoned updates.

sources.title: GitHub, PyPI add time-absed defenses against supply chain attacks

topics.title: SourTrade Malvertising Builds Malware in the Browser
topics.latest_developments: Confiant detailed SourTrade on July 23, 2026, a malvertising operation that since late 2024 has impersonated TradingView, Solana, and Luno to feed retail traders malware in fragments that the victim's own browser assembles into a Windows executable atop a legitimate Bun runtime.
topics.summary: The technique defeats scanners that hunt one complete malicious file at a fixed URL, since no single download carries the payload. Retail traders landing on fake trading sites should distrust browser-driven downloads and installer prompts.

sources.title: Malvertising Sends Malware in Pieces, Then Makes the Browser Build the Executable
Malicious sites use JavaScript to build malware in browser memory

topics.title: Unpatched Fastjson RCE Under Active Exploitation
topics.latest_developments: ThreatBook and Imperva reported July 25, 2026 that attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-16723, a critical remote-code-execution flaw in Alibaba's Fastjson 1.x Java library, before any patch exists.
topics.summary: Fastjson 1.x parses JSON in Java; on affected Spring Boot applications a malicious JSON request runs code without authentication at the privileges of the Java process, and Alibaba assigns the flaw a CVSS score of 9.0. Teams still running Fastjson 1.x should isolate or replace it since no fix ships.

sources.title: Fastjson 1.x RCE Vulnerability Targeted in Attacks With No Patched Available

topics.title: DevMan RaaS Portal Centralizes Affiliate Operations
topics.latest_developments: PRODAFT disclosed July 25, 2026 that the DevMan ransomware-as-a-service operation, which it tracks as Funky Mantis, runs a single web portal that builds payloads, manages victims, and handles affiliate payouts.
topics.summary: The portal lowers the skill floor for affiliates by folding build generation, victim management, and finance into one console. Defenders now face a professionalized DevMan operation that scales through its recruits.

sources.title: DevMan RaaS Portal Centralizes Payload Builds, Victim Management, and Affiliate Payouts

topics.title: Hermes AI Agent Automates Ministry Breach
topics.latest_developments: A threat actor ran the open-source Hermes AI agent in unattended "YOLO" mode to automate post-exploitation during an alleged breach of Thailand's Ministry of Finance, BleepingComputer reported July 24, 2026.
topics.summary: Hermes acts on its own once given a foothold, chaining reconnaissance and lateral movement without an operator at the keyboard. The case shows criminals wiring off-the-shelf AI agents directly into live intrusions.

sources.title: Hermes AI agent used to automate attack on Thai Finance Ministry

topics.title: OnTrac Breach Exposes Customer Data
topics.latest_developments: OnTrac, the regional parcel-delivery carrier, began notifying customers on July 24, 2026 that intruders breached its corporate network and may have reached their personal details.
topics.summary: OnTrac has not yet detailed the exposed data or named the attacker. Customers should watch for fraud and phishing that leans on their delivery-account information.

sources.title: OnTrac notifies customers of data breach after network hack

business.title: United to Drop Some Middle Seats
business.latest_developments: United Airlines disclosed it will pull middle seats from part of its fleet, and the Post-Gazette reports cabin economics, rather than passenger distaste, drive the move.
business.summary: United Airlines plans to reconfigure sections of its aircraft to eliminate certain middle seats, a change the carrier ties to the math of premium and extra-legroom seating rather than to travelers' well-known dislike of the middle.

sources.title: Airline passengers hate middle seats. But that's not why United is getting rid of some of them

around_town.title: Severe Weather Days This Week
around_town.latest_developments: Forecasters posted a Severe Weather Alert Day for Monday night into Tuesday, July 27 and 28, with rounds of storms crossing western Pennsylvania over three days as another wildfire-smoke plume drifted about 7,000 feet above the region Sunday.
around_town.summary: Meteorologists at WTAE and KDKA warned of repeated thunderstorms across western Pennsylvania through midweek, flagging Monday night into Tuesday as the sharpest threat, while a high-altitude wildfire-smoke plume hazed Pittsburgh skies Sunday without fouling surface air quality the way the Code Purple smoke did earlier in July.

sources.title: Severe weather and wildfire smoke could return to Pittsburgh this week
Western PA: Impact Day followed by Severe Weather Alert Days

around_town.title: Region Nears Tornado Record
around_town.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette detailed why the Pittsburgh region stands on the verge of setting an annual record for tornadoes after a summer of repeated touchdowns across western Pennsylvania.
around_town.summary: Western Pennsylvania is tracking toward the most tornadoes ever recorded in a single year, the Post-Gazette reported, after the National Weather Service confirmed a string of touchdowns across counties including Westmoreland and Jefferson during this month's storms.

sources.title: Why the Pittsburgh region is on the verge of setting an annual record for tornadoes

around_town.title: City Weighs Teen Takeovers
around_town.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette examined how Pittsburgh officials are searching for answers to the mass teen gatherings, or takeovers, that have drawn large crowds downtown and prompted the new Market Square youth curfew.
around_town.summary: Pittsburgh leaders are hunting for a response to spontaneous mass gatherings of teenagers around Market Square and downtown, the Post-Gazette reported, weighing options after the city imposed a youth curfew that now faces its own legal challenge.

sources.title: Pittsburgh searches for answers on mass teen gatherings

around_teams.title: Pittman Can Unlock the Passing Game
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette's training-camp countdown argued Sunday that receiver Michael Pittman Jr. can open up Mike McCarthy's passing attack.
around_teams.summary: The Post-Gazette's Steelers camp countdown cast newly added wideout Michael Pittman Jr. as a reliable possession target who can stretch Mike McCarthy's offense and give quarterback Aaron Rodgers a dependable option opposite DK Metcalf as Latrobe camp nears.

sources.title: Steelers training camp countdown: Michael Pittman Jr. can open up Mike McCarthy's passing attack

team_usa.title: USWNT's Path to the 2027 Final
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN, at the one-year mark before the 2027 Women's World Cup final, laid out five reasons the United States women's national team will or will not reach it.
team_usa.summary: With exactly one year remaining until the 2027 Women's World Cup final, ESPN weighed the case for and against a United States women's national team return to the title game, assessing its form, depth, and rivals as the tournament approaches.

sources.title: 5 reasons the USWNT will (or won't) be in the Women's World Cup final in one year

team_usa.title: Barcelona Sign U.S. Keeper McCamey
team_usa.latest_developments: Barcelona signed American goalkeeper Tyler McCamey for its women's team, the reigning European champions, the club announced Saturday.
team_usa.summary: FC Barcelona added United States goalkeeper Tyler McCamey to the roster of its women's side, winners of the European title, in a move giving another American a place at one of the sport's dominant clubs.
